title: DisasterDoc controlled false-recovery characterization cases
scope: Evaluation-only direct calls to classify_field through a synthetic harness; no OCR engine or full image pipeline was run.
ground_truth_policy: ground_truth is evaluation-only metadata read by the runner after classification; it is never passed to src, MappedField, Observation, pipeline state, or production evidence.
confidence_note: ocr_confidence is injected as a controlled classifier input. It is not an OCR-engine measurement or a calibrated probability of correctness.
damage_note: Damage profiles are deterministic DamageMap masks injected directly into the classifier harness. They are not rendered images and do not test build_damage_map or OCR robustness.
